rounds.fact: WebCrawler, launched in 1994, was the first search engine to provide full-text search of the web, a basic feature that wasn't yet standard among its competitors.
Blogger launched in 1999 and is one of the tools credited with popularizing the word 'blog' itself, before Google acquired it in 2003.
Flickr started in 2004 as a side feature of an online game before its photo-sharing tools became popular enough that the game was scrapped entirely.
Tucows started in 1993 as a curated shareware download library (the name stood for 'The Ultimate Collection of Winsock Software') before evolving into an internet services company.
LAUNCH (later LAUNCHcast) was one of Yahoo's earliest music properties, offering personalized internet radio years before Pandora or Spotify existed.
